item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This is not horrible, but ultimately, I dislike it.

For one, I'm not a fan of the sort of pathetic, perhaps, tone this is written in, though I realize it's fairly common among fantasy literature - it's a personal preference.

However, beyond that, this is little but a big lump of exposition joined together with a strand of not all that believable inner monologue. I know how hard it is to do try to convey this sort of information in tale form, my "keeping with the times" was a similar attempt (and not a hugely rated one) , but I dare say I at least included some non-generic characterization of comrade Bezukladnikov there.

And, beyond that, the entire canon seems… way more disconnected from the original setting than Doctors of the Church or Bellerverse - almost as if the connection to the present-day Foundationverse is more of an excuse to justify having it here than something integral to it.

Ultimately, I can't do but downvote.
